data.one_liner: Flutter logging package with integrated UI, log levels, performance optimizations, and optional security.
data.what_it_does: Logman provides logging features for Flutter apps including multiple log levels, tagged logging, performance management like lazy loading and background processing, and an optional visual overlay with PIN/password protection.
use_when: You need in-app debugging and log visualization during development.
You want to track network requests (via Dio) and navigation events automatically.
You require password or PIN protection to secure logs in production environments.
avoid_when: You only need standard console print statements without any UI or management features.
strengths: Includes an integrated UI overlay and customizable debug page.
Supports performance optimizations like lazy loading and virtual scrolling for thousands of logs.
Offers built-in security features such as PIN/password protection and session management.
weaknesses: Relies on a singleton pattern which may limit architectural flexibility.
Adding an overlay and interceptors requires manual wiring throughout the app root.
data.setup_notes: Initialize Logman in your app's root by attaching the overlay using WidgetsBinding or passing a navigator observer.
